title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a high‑energy late‑summer ’82 show with rocking Bertha > Promised Land transitions and a tight, 12‑song first set.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its incredible overall sound, delivering a clear matrix mix that lets the band’s late‑summer 1982 energy shine through. Reviewers highlight a powerful opening stretch—Bertha into The Promised Land, Candyman into C.C. Rider and other seamless segues—making the first set feel both tight and exhilarating.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on both performance (high energy, great song flow) and recording quality (excellent matrix sound). Two 5‑star reviews and one enthusiastic but oddly rated review give consistent high praise.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the overall sound as incredible; no complaints about muddiness, dropouts or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set runs twelve tunes with several seamless segues, maintaining strong momentum and a rock‑driven opening.
